instruction: A candid wide-angle photograph from a slightly high angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the center-right, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands facing away. On the center-left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) leans forward, pushing his shoulder with her hands while extending her left leg backward. The background shows white walls and studio equipment. The room is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the floor.
